newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse closes up in extended rush.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse closes up in extended rush.

text.p: Most Bucharest stock exchange closing prices climbed on Monday in heavy buying interest extended from the previous week.

"Demand, mostly from foreign investors, stayed high and we expect the mood to keep up for at least one more session," said a trader. "A correction is bound to happen, but no one can say exactly when."
Volume thinned slightly to 2.6 million shares from 2.7 million last Friday, while turnover gained some 380 million lei to 11.38 billion.
Fourteen stocks ended higher, 11 slipped and six remained unchanged. Ten companies had no trade and two were suspended.

Two independent market indices, the VAB and the CAS-SE, based on average prices and market capitalisation, climbed to fresh year highs, rising by 2.1 and 2.09 respectively from last Friday. Another unofficial index, the BIG, was unavailable.
The first tier dominated trading, accounting for 75 percent of turnover. Traders said first-tier stocks would stay in demand on Tuesday. But they expected a fall soon in quotes.
Four of the seven high-caps closed higher and two dropped. Arctic refrigerator maker remained suspended.

Oltchim chemical plant ended 150 lei firmer at 3,550 and vehicle parts maker Compa gained 200 lei to close at 3,700. Fertiliser maker Azomures and Terapia pharmaceuticals picked up 100 lei each to close at 3,850 and 7,400 respectively.
Fertiliser maker Sofert and Antibiotice pharmaceuticals closed lower in what a traders called last- minute deals. Sofert lost 1,000 lei to 32,000 and Antibiotice ended 50 lei weaker at 7,250.
On the second tier, Policolor dye maker remained in focus, rising 150 lei to a 6,450 close and getting 1.77 billion lei in turnover.
